requirement: Auditor identity, competence and independence are established.
requiredEvidence: Signed human attestation and conflict disclosure.

requirement: The auditor had no confirmatory outcome access before signing.
requiredEvidence: Signed no-outcome-access attestation and access-ledger review.

requirement: Run ID, cutoff, audit-package freeze time and candidate remote commit are exact.
requiredEvidence: Pre-audit run binding and candidate remote commit.

requirement: The exact full input file is byte-rehashed.
requiredEvidence: Input-file SHA-256 matching the frozen pre-audit run package.

requirement: All eight raw input components and the research-corpus identity are rehashed.
requiredEvidence: Complete componentManifest with independent recomputation.

requirement: All ten prerequisite non-code gate artifacts and every cited evidence file are rehashed from candidate remote history.
requiredEvidence: Prerequisite gate-evidence file plus remote artifact/evidence hashes; independentAuditPassed remains RED until this audit is signed.

requirement: Entity, security and listing identities are effective-dated without ticker projection.
requiredEvidence: Population checks and sampled identity/listing reproductions.

requirement: The append-only SEC store preserves raw revisions, accessions and acceptance chronology.
requiredEvidence: Revision/population manifests and sampled raw payload rehashes.

requirement: The historical universe includes exits, failures, acquisitions and delistings without survivorship bias.
requiredEvidence: Point-in-time membership and exit samples.

requirement: Later facts cannot enter earlier states anywhere in the ingestion path.
requiredEvidence: Negative time-shift injections and chronology samples.

requirement: Adjusted OHLCV provenance and split/dividend treatment are complete.
requiredEvidence: Vendor/source provenance, adjustment tests and sampled bars.

requirement: Corporate actions, security continuity and delisting returns are effective-dated.
requiredEvidence: Action-ledger and return-policy reproductions.

requirement: Historical GQS states use only then-known facts under the frozen formula identity.
requiredEvidence: Adapter replay, remote seal and selected snapshot reproductions.

requirement: The frozen concept map is semantically approved and bound to the exact input.
requiredEvidence: Independent concept-map semantic audit and run-bound component hash.

requirement: Two independent blinded coders meet the sealed agreement thresholds.
requiredEvidence: Coder independence, kappa and exact-agreement artifacts.

requirement: The corpus is sealed before outcome access and cannot expand selectively.
requiredEvidence: Corpus manifest, queries, cutoffs, source classes and content hashes.

requirement: Candidate, control, technical-only and H-LATE populations are complete and non-reused as specified.
requiredEvidence: Population counts, deterministic matching and non-reuse tests.

requirement: Auditor samples cover every locked time split and every required gate area.
requiredEvidence: Dated sampling log with reproducible commands and evidence paths.

requirement: Protocol, runner and numerical runtime are the exact sealed versions.
requiredEvidence: Protocol manifest, runtime lock and repository audit output.

requirement: Every prerequisite verification predates the audit-package freeze; final authorization and outcome access remain absent.
requiredEvidence: Timezone-qualified prerequisite evidence, package-freeze time and signed no-outcome-access attestation.

requirement: Every finding is classified, evidenced and dispositioned.
requiredEvidence: Complete findings register linked to checklist items.

requirement: No unresolved P0, P1 or P2 remains at signature time.
requiredEvidence: Findings register with resolution evidence and signed closure.
